ns2:section.sectionText: The Just Infrastructures Speaker Series was created by researchers in the Computer Science Department at the University of Illinois, the School of Information Sciences and the College of Media to interrogate the complex interactions between people, algorithms, and AI-driven systems. This speaker series includes presentations by leaders in their respective fields addressing people, data, algorithms, and the infrastructures that bind them.
ns2:section.sectionCappArea: Not intended for First Time Freshman students.
